name: Biryani
summary: Wide plate of orange-and-white spiced rice with a chicken leg and herbs; for Indian feast and celebration meal scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the plate rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the plate is hero size (~500 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, pop = scale in with overshoot
